**Finding: compliant (at fallback) — ¶ 4(a) (p0016).**

The document's only convenience-termination mechanic is in paragraph 4(a) of the Term and Termination article; there is no Exhibit-level or separate early-termination-fee provision.

Why it clears the fallback:
- **Committed term is 1 year**, with 1-year auto-renewals — not a multi-year lock-in, so the "no Customer convenience right in a term longer than 12 months" deviation test is not triggered.
- **Our convenience right:** termination for any reason following the Initial Term on 90 days' notice — at the outer edge of the 60–90 day fallback window.
- **Vendor's right is symmetrical and end-of-term only:** Kubient may terminate for convenience only following the Initial Term, on 90 days' notice — exactly the fallback, and not the walk-away case (Vendor exit mid-term or on fewer than 90 days).
- **No penalty:** Kubient's entitlement to "all fees generated during the termination period" is payment for services actually delivered during the 90-day notice window and in any event stays within the fallback's 3-months'-fees ceiling.

Noted in the rationale but deliberately **not** redlined (minor sub-elements short of the preferred position): no express pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and no right to terminate individual Exhibits in part. Worth raising as drafting comments only if this clause is reopened for other reasons.
